statement: Patch is a smaller one before the elemental sorcerer update, with quality of life changes.
Pet Arena now has a high performance mode that greatly reduces lag, so mobile and PC players can reach wave 200 without long waits.
He tested up to 200k per dump and it still ran at 60 fps with no white screens; he is on wave 250 plus.
Keybinds are now in the game: WASD to move and R to attack; everything can be keybound.
He was mad about keybinds at first, but after using them thinks it is a fantastic update; no more accidentally clicking portals.
Quick trash added to ovals so you can click instead of drag and drop.
Limited time gem shop now has two Divinity pearls for three gems; he says pick those up.
World 5 shop now sells ancient artifacts if you have the normal artifact unlocked; you can buy two per week.
Ancient artifact purchase means less RNG; he spent three weeks trying to get Socrates and now has it.
Salt Lick got a massive cost nerf, making things like Dune Souls, mousies, pinkies and frigid souls much easier to buy.
The big bubble (green cauldron) no longer needs to be equipped for the plus one trap; it is always plus one trap.
When trapping you still want the big bubble equipped, because it gives trapping efficiency.
Gaming box pong minigame now officially implemented, so it gives the bit multiplier; before you could play it without a multi.
Gaming Evergreen plant gave a flat rate bug; it now gives a randomized bit amount as intended.
Bug fixed where opening the new loot filter removed the fourth spot.
Over accurate crit star talent fixed: required 1.5 times accuracy to crit and now requires 1 times; more crit chance.
Seven new world 5 constellations were added giving 35 star points in total.
Locations: World 5 town, Niagara Falls, Cracker Jack Lake, Ruptured River, OJ Bay, the miners mole map, and Trevor worms.
Ram plushie giveaway winner announced as neuteron.
